details.name: Camille
details.quote: Camille Arno, Agaš'mekanaz of Seš'qa. I seek a dangerous Sarkaz criminal who wields witchcraft as a weapon. For this, I require the strength of Endfield... And in return, I vow to offer you my own.
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Situational Analysis: Keeper's Insight He is skilled at revealing things, no matter how meticulously they have been hidden.
details.exp2d: Agility: Hemosensitive Tracker No being living in blood could ever escape him.
details.hb1d: Creative: Witchcraft Jigsaw It started with a curious study of Sarkazian witchcraft, but now he simply enjoys the cycle of breaking everything apart and putting the pieces back together.
details.hb2d: Technology: Gear Collection Display racks, and lots of them. They are his only requirement for a safe house. This way, he can carefully categorize and arrange various equipment by brand and function.
details.matskill: Blessing of Lustrous Carmine, Beacon of Duty, JET
